Wj5aDKR_sYbS6g.transcript: Good morning. Please have a seat. What brings you in today? Good morning, Doctor. I have been having a headache for the past three days. Can you describe the headache? Where exactly does it hurt? Mostly on both sides of my body. It feels like a constant pressure rather than a sharp pain. On a scale 1 to 10, how severe it is? Around 6 out of 10. When did it first start? It started three days ago. I've been getting it mostly in the afternoon and evening. Does anything make it better or worse? Resting in a quiet room helps a little. Looking at my laptop for a long time seems to make it worse. Have you experienced vomiting, blood, vision, fever, fever or dizziness? No, vomiting or fever. Sometimes my eyes feel tired, but I haven't had blood, vision or dizziness. Have you taken any medication for it? I took one paracetamol tablet yesterday. It helped for a few hours, but the headache came back. Have you had headaches like this before? Occasionally, but they usually go away after few hours. This is the first time it has lasted for several days. How has your sleep been recently? Not very good. I've been sleeping around five to six hours because I've been working late on my laptop. How much water do you usually drink during the day? Probably around four or five glasses. I know that's probably not enough.

note.assessment: Headache lasting for several days, possibly tension-related, associated with screen time, poor sleep, and dehydration.

Resting in a quiet room helps slightly, while looking at a laptop for a long time makes it worse. Patient denies vomiting, fever, blood, vision changes, or dizziness, though notes tired eyes. Patient took one paracetamol tablet yesterday which helped for a few hours. Sleep has been poor (5-6 hours per night due to working late on laptop) and water intake is low (4-5 glasses per day).
